title: Choose the visual world
question: Safer hand. Two re-rolls in: what felt wrong before — too clever, too civil, too software, too paper? These are remaining yard objects you already live with, plus the category standard against SimPRO, Tradify, and AroFlo. The roll is suspended; you pick.

options.label: Cab Run Sheet
options.lineage: laminated visor cards and Sharpie run sheets
options.thesis: The homepage is the day's laminated sheet in the sun visor: jobs, plant, variations, certificates, capture, then Xero.
options.viewport: A landscape laminated sheet filling the browser: D1 stamp in the corner, ruled columns for the ops layer, Book a yard visit as the footer Sharpie line.
options.risk: Reads as a PDF form in a browser, and can feel as thin as the docket-pipe hero we already rejected.

options.label: Pre-Start Logbook
options.lineage: cab pre-start pads and daily plant books
options.thesis: The homepage is the book they already sign before the key turns; the ops layer is today's pages.
options.viewport: An open landscape logbook: left page the catch, right page today's rows for jobs, plant, variations, certificates, capture; Book a yard visit is the sign-off line.
options.risk: Looks like a safety-compliance product, not a custom operations system.

options.label: Workshop Shadow Board
options.lineage: tool shadow boards on workshop walls
options.thesis: The homepage is a shadow board: every ops layer has an outline, and you can see what's missing from across the shed.
options.viewport: A landscape plywood board: outlines labelled jobs, costing, plant, variations, certificates, capture; one outline empty; Book a yard visit is a hanging tag.
options.risk: Reads as a workshop brand film, and the empty-hook metaphor can feel cute rather than operational.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: Sit next to SimPRO, Tradify, and AroFlo: dark trade-software marketing, executed at their craft level, without irony.
canonCard.viewport: A dark SaaS hero, a job-app screenshot, three feature columns, and Book a yard visit in the header.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from those three by design.
